Topics covered in this PDF

BHIE-107 (Modern Europe Mid-18th to Mid-20th Centuries) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Demands for reform in 18th century Britain, Italian nationalism, secret societies in Europe, theories of imperialism, the Nazi rise to power
  • Five-year planning in Russia, the Reform Act of 1832, the New Economic Policy

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: all questions compulsory, total marks 100, assignment code EHI-07/BHIE-107/AST/TMA/2026-27. Section 1: two questions of 20 marks, each with an OR choice (about 500 words). Section 2: four questions of 12 marks, each with an OR choice (about 250 words). Section 3: short notes on any two of four topics, 6+6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
